text:
oliver: Quick sync 1: I started a branch to harmonize v1 -> v2 examples across the site. Noticed inconsistencies in curl headers, the Python sample using old kwargs, and missing Go/Ruby snippets. Branch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/tree/harmonize-v1v2-examples
neha: nice. Do you plan to replace v1 examples or keep compatibility variants? we should not break docs copy for customers still on the shim.
tomas: i'd prefer canonical v2 live-first, with a concise compatibility paragraph and a collapsible v1->v2 mapping on each guide page. that keeps the docs clean.
oliver: agreed. Plan: canonical v2 examples, 1-line banner noting compatibility + a small collapsible mapping (param rename table) per page. also add minimal Go/Ruby devkit snippets.
kai: FYI the embed quickstart still references embed-legacy-512. we'll need an alias note pointing to rwd-embed-512-v2 and mention the alias_map.json.
docs-ci-bot: [ci] example-lint failure on examples/generation.md: curl header X-Old-Auth is invalid, use Authorization: Bearer <key>.
oliver: thanks bot. i'll sweep curl examples and fix headers; also swap models.invoke -> client.responses.create in examples.
neha: can we also include a tiny streaming usage note? a number of users ask how to move from incremental websocket style to the new stream iterator. two-line example is ideal.
tomas: i can add Go and Ruby snippets + the streaming handler update. will also update tests. ETA 3 hours.
kai: i'll add the embed alias note and a one-line migration callout in embeddings.md. also will add a link to the full alias_map in the footnote.
oliver: suggested v1->v2 mapping bullets for collapsible: 
- model_id -> model
- output_format -> type
- max_tokens -> max_output_tokens
- stop_sequences -> stop
- functions -> tools
Keep it short.
neha: for curl, please show both non-stream and stream forms. example replace (old curl):
```bash
# v1 style
curl -H "X-Old-Auth: $KEY" -d '{"model":"gpt-3.5","input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/invoke
```
with v2 canonical:
```bash
# v2 canonical
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"gpt-4o-mini","input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v2/responses
```
and a short stream note: `--no-buffer` + newline-delimited chunks, or recommend SDK stream helper.
docs-ci-bot: [ci] queued example tests for branch harmonize-v1v2-examples.
tomas: pushed Go + Ruby snippets and streaming fix. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/901/files
kai: pushed embed alias note. added footnote pointing to /assets/alias_map_v2.json and a short migration example for embeddings.
neha: small UX ask: add a collapsible "Why we moved to responses.create" with 2 bullets (unified schema, streaming/function changes). helps answer the question in-situ.
oliver: good idea. also product asked for a one-line entry for the deprecation comms: "Docs examples consolidated to v2 canonical patterns; v1 shim supported until 2025-12-31." Sarah from comms will write the message.
release-bot: [release] docs branch harmonize-v1v2-examples scheduled for canary publish in ~30m if CI green.
tomas: local smoke tests passed. waiting on the examples CI job.
docs-ci-bot: [ci] examples job failed on one test: examples/streaming.md expected a streamChunk handler that we removed; tomography needed.
tomas: fixed the test and re-ran. queued again.
kai: reviewer request: @oliver @neha please review embed alias wording and the mapping bullets.
oliver: reviewing now. the Go snippet uses the new Client.Responses API pattern? ensure it's idiomatic for the language.
tomas: used the pattern analogous to other SDKs: client.Responses.Create(ctx, &ResponsesCreateParams{Model: "gpt-4o-mini", Input: "hi"}) — if that needs tweak, lmk.
neha: lgtm overall. small nit on the curl example: show status code handling sample.
oliver: sounds good. final action items: (1) Tomas: merge PR once CI green and tests pass; (2) Kai: confirm embed alias_map link and add changelog line; (3) Neha: write the deprecation blurb for product to include in email; (4) Oliver: quick pass on idiomatic SDK snippets.
tomas: will merge after green. thanks everyone. :tada:
